column1: # Format: <seconds><TAB><prompt>. Do exactly what each prompt says, then stop
# and wait for the next one. Do nothing at all during the IDLE steps -- they
# establish the background report rate everything else is measured against.
# Step 2 is a liveness check, not data: moving the pointer over the phone view
# is known to make Device Hub send AbsolutePointer reports. If that window is
# empty the taps are not bound and every negative result in the run is void.

column2: LIVENESS: move the mouse slowly back and forth over the phone view
Press Command-L to LOCK the screen, then stop
Unlock the phone however Device Hub normally does it, then stop
Two-finger scroll DOWN on the trackpad over the phone view, twice
Two-finger scroll UP on the trackpad over the phone view, twice
